description: List synced private X bookmarks and folders for a creator so agents can generate ideas, bookmark remixes, quote drafts, replies, and resource posts from saved inspiration.

folder_id.description: Only return bookmarks from this native X folder ID.

folder_name.description: Only return bookmarks from this exact native X folder name.

search.description: Case-insensitive content filter applied after creator scoping.

since.description: Only return bookmarks imported at or after this ISO timestamp.

name: bamf.list_x_bookmarks
